species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 49°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 14–70 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 90 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 135 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 49°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–20 ft deep, mostly on sheltered coves.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 90 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 135 ft, so fish stay above it.
West wind at 17 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
